text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A performance isn't just about sound.
It's an art expressed with the entire body.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A graceful musician harbors graceful music.
Thus, oh, what a dire predicament this is...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: My tail hair just won't stay in place...! And the concert is tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to get his tail care right, Sounds of Earth felt deeply unsettled.
